title: Fantastic tour
text: What a fantastic guide! Alba, born herself in Granada, is very personable, enthusiastic and knowledgeable. Her communication even before our visit was excellent and this excellence continued throughout our tour. Thank you Alba for bringing the Alhambra to life for us. Truly a 5 star guide! !

title: Generalife and Nasrid palaces
text: I visited the Alhambra and the experience was great. Alba, the guide, was super pleasant, friendly, and approachable throughout the entire visit. He explained everything to us in a very pleasant way and it was clear that he enjoyed his work. Without a doubt, a visit I would repeat and that I totally recommend.
author: A8055DVjavierr

title: Brilliant Alhambra tour!
text:
Alba was an incredible tour guide! Her friendliness and knowledge made the trip so special, and she got some incredible photos of us. Her local knowledge of both the Alhambra and Granada meant she was able to give us great recommendations for viewpoints and restaurants, and she answered all questions with ease. When we return we will be booking with her again!

We booked super last minute and it was so easy, tickets were sorted quickly and communication before the tour started was brilliant.

Thank you Alba!
author: O4968FLemmas
